description: This file contains unit tests for utility functions in the OpenClaw project, including date age formatting, SSH target parsing, connection settings, gateway entry point determination, and log file selection.

classes.name: UtilitiesTests
classes.description: A test suite grouping various utility function tests.

methods.name: age strings cover common windows
methods.description: Tests the age formatting function with different time intervals.

methods.name: parse SSH target supports user port and defaults
methods.description: Verifies parsing of SSH target strings with various configurations.

methods.name: sanitized target strips leading SSH prefix
methods.description: Checks that the remote target string is correctly sanitized and defaults applied.

methods.name: gateway entrypoint prefers dist over bin
methods.description: Ensures the gateway entry point selects the dist version when both are present.

methods.name: log locator picks newest log file
methods.description: Verifies that the latest log file by modification date is selected.

methods.name: gateway entrypoint nil when missing
methods.description: Tests that the gateway entry point returns nil if no files are present.
